044/**
045 * Implement a Robot Program framework. The RobotBase class is intended to be subclassed to create a
046 * robot program. The user must implement {@link #startCompetition()}, which will be called once and
047 * is not expected to exit. The user must also implement {@link #endCompetition()}, which signals to
048 * the code in {@link #startCompetition()} that it should exit.
049 *
050 * <p>It is not recommended to subclass this class directly - instead subclass IterativeRobotBase or
051 * TimedRobot.
052 */
053public abstract class RobotBase implements AutoCloseable {
054  private static final String PROGRAM_START_TIME_TOPIC = "/Robot/ProgramStartTime";
055  private static final String WPILIB_VERSION_TOPIC = "/Robot/WPILibVersion";
056  private static final AtomicInteger s_nextWarningReporterId = new AtomicInteger();
057
058  /** The ID of the main Java thread. */
059  // This is usually 1, but it is best to make sure
060  private static long m_threadId = -1;
061
062  private final MultiSubscriber m_suball;
063  private final IntegerPublisher m_programStartTimePublisher;
064  private final StringPublisher m_wpilibVersionPublisher;
065  private final Map<String, Alert> m_telemetryWarningAlerts = new HashMap<>();
066  private final Map<String, Alert> m_tunableWarningAlerts = new HashMap<>();
067  private final BiConsumer<String, String> m_telemetryWarningReporter =
068      this::reportTelemetryWarning;
069  private final Consumer<String> m_tunableWarningReporter = this::reportTunableWarning;
070  private final String m_warningAlertIdPrefix =
071      "warning" + s_nextWarningReporterId.getAndIncrement() + "_";
072  private final AtomicInteger m_nextWarningAlertId = new AtomicInteger();
073
074  private final int m_connListenerHandle;
075
076  private static void setupMathShared() {
077    MathSharedStore.setMathShared(
078        new MathShared() {
079          @Override
080          public void reportError(String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
081            DriverStationErrors.reportError(error, stackTrace);
082          }
083
084          @Override
085          public double getTimestamp() {
086            return Timer.getTimestamp();
087          }
088        });
089  }
090
091  private void reportTelemetryWarning(String path, String msg) {
092    reportWarningAlert(
093        m_telemetryWarningAlerts,
094        "Telemetry",
095        path + '\n' + msg,
096        "Telemetry '" + path + "': warning: " + msg);
097  }
098
099  private void reportTunableWarning(String msg) {
100    reportWarningAlert(m_tunableWarningAlerts, "Tunables", msg, "Tunable warning: " + msg);
101  }
102
103  private void reportWarningAlert(
104      Map<String, Alert> alerts, String group, String key, String text) {
105    synchronized (alerts) {
106      Alert alert = alerts.get(key);
107      if (alert == null) {
108        alert =
109            new Alert(
110                group,
111                m_warningAlertIdPrefix + m_nextWarningAlertId.getAndIncrement(),
112                text,
113                Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
114        alerts.put(key, alert);
115      }
116
117      alert.setText(text);
118      alert.set(true);
119    }
120  }
121
122  private static void closeWarningAlerts(Map<String, Alert> alerts) {
123    synchronized (alerts) {
124      for (Alert alert : alerts.values()) {
125        alert.close();
126      }
127      alerts.clear();
128    }
129  }

131  @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
132  private static class TunableMeasure extends Tunable<Measure> implements Tunable.CustomTunable {
133    TunableMeasure(Measure initialValue, TunableConfig config) {
134      super(config);
135      m_unit = initialValue.unit();
136      m_baseUnit = m_unit.getBaseUnit();
137      m_value = initialValue;
138      m_magnitudeTunable =
139          new TunableDouble(config, true) {
140            @Override
141            public void set(double value) {
142              m_value = m_unit.ofBaseUnits(value);
143              markChanged();
144            }
145
146            @Override
147            public double get() {
148              return m_value.baseUnitMagnitude();
149            }
150          };
151    }
152
153    @Override
154    public void set(Measure value) {
155      if (!m_baseUnit.equivalent(value.unit().getBaseUnit())) {
156        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
157            "Measure unit " + value.unit() + " is not compatible with " + m_unit);
158      }
159      m_magnitudeTunable.set(value.baseUnitMagnitude());
160    }
161
162    @Override
163    public Measure get() {
164      return m_value;
165    }
166
167    @Override
168    public Measure mutate() {
169      m_magnitudeTunable.set(m_value.baseUnitMagnitude());
170      return m_value;
171    }
172
173    @Override
174    public TunableDouble getInnerTunable() {
175      return m_magnitudeTunable;
176    }
177
178    @Override
179    public boolean hasChanged() {
180      return m_magnitudeTunable.hasChanged();
181    }
182
183    @Override
184    public boolean supportsChangeNotification() {
185      return m_magnitudeTunable.supportsChangeNotification();
186    }
187
188    @Override
189    public void resetChanged() {
190      m_magnitudeTunable.resetChanged();
191    }
192
193    @Override
194    public Class<Measure> getTypeClass() {
195      return Measure.class;
196    }
197
198    private final Unit m_unit;
199    private final Unit m_baseUnit;
200    private Measure m_value;
201    private final TunableDouble m_magnitudeTunable;
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * Constructor for a generic robot program. User code can be placed in the constructor that runs
206   * before the Autonomous or Operator Control period starts. The constructor will run to completion
207   * before Autonomous is entered.
208   *
209   * <p>This must be used to ensure that the communications code starts. In the future it would be
210   * nice to put this code into its own task that loads on boot so ensure that it runs.
211   */
212  @SuppressWarnings("this-escape")
213  protected RobotBase() {
214    final NetworkTableInstance inst = NetworkTableInstance.getDefault();
215    m_threadId = Thread.currentThread().threadId();
216    setupMathShared();
217    // subscribe to "" to force persistent values to propagate to local
218    m_suball = new MultiSubscriber(inst, new String[] {""}, PubSubOption.DISABLE_SIGNAL);
219    if (!isSimulation()) {
220      inst.startServer("/home/systemcore/networktables.json", "", "robot");
221    } else {
222      inst.startServer("networktables.json", "", "robot");
223    }
224
225    // set up telemetry
226    TelemetryRegistry.setReportWarning(m_telemetryWarningReporter);
227    TelemetryRegistry.registerBackend("", new NetworkTablesTelemetryBackend(inst, "/Telemetry"));
228    TelemetryRegistry.registerTypeHandler(
229        Measure.class,
230        (table, name, value) -> {
231          UnitTelemetry.log(table, name, value);
232        });
233
234    // set up tunables
235    TunableRegistry.setReportWarning(m_tunableWarningReporter);
236    TunableRegistry.registerBackend("", new NetworkTablesTunableBackend(inst, "/Tunables"));
237    TunableRegistry.registerTypeHandler(
238        Measure.class,
239        (initialValue, config) -> {
240          if (config == null) {
241            config = new TunableConfig();
242          }
243          return new TunableMeasure(
244              initialValue,
245              config.withProperty(
246                  "unit", UnitTelemetry.getUnitMetadata(initialValue.unit().getBaseUnit())));
247        });
248
249    // wait for the NT server to actually start
250    try {
251      int count = 0;
252      while (inst.getNetworkMode().contains(NetworkTableInstance.NetworkMode.STARTING)) {
253        Thread.sleep(10);
254        count++;
255        if (count > 100) {
256          throw new InterruptedException();
257        }
258      }
259    } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
260      System.err.println("timed out while waiting for NT server to start");
261    }
262
263    m_programStartTimePublisher = inst.getIntegerTopic(PROGRAM_START_TIME_TOPIC).publish();
264    m_programStartTimePublisher.set(WPIUtilJNI.getProgramStartTime());
265
266    m_wpilibVersionPublisher = inst.getStringTopic(WPILIB_VERSION_TOPIC).publish();
267    m_wpilibVersionPublisher.set(WPILibVersion.Version);
268
269    m_connListenerHandle =
270        inst.addConnectionListener(
271            false,
272            event -> {
273              if (event.is(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.CONNECTED)) {
274                UsageReporting.reportUsage("NT/" + event.connInfo.remoteId, "");
275              }
276            });
277  }
278
279  /**
280   * Returns the main thread ID.
281   *
282   * @return The main thread ID.
283   */
284  public static long getMainThreadId() {
285    return m_threadId;
286  }
287
288  @Override
289  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
290  public void close() {
291    if (TelemetryRegistry.getReportWarning() == m_telemetryWarningReporter) {
292      TelemetryRegistry.setReportWarning(null);
293    }
294    if (TunableRegistry.getReportWarning() == m_tunableWarningReporter) {
295      TunableRegistry.setReportWarning(null);
296    }
297    closeWarningAlerts(m_telemetryWarningAlerts);
298    closeWarningAlerts(m_tunableWarningAlerts);
299    m_suball.close();
300    m_programStartTimePublisher.close();
301    m_wpilibVersionPublisher.close();
302    NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().removeListener(m_connListenerHandle);
303  }

431  /**
432   * Start the main robot code. This function will be called once and should not exit until
433   * signalled by {@link #endCompetition()}
434   */
435  public abstract void startCompetition();
436
437  /** Ends the main loop in {@link #startCompetition()}. */
438  public abstract void endCompetition();
439
440  private static final ReentrantLock m_runMutex = new ReentrantLock();
441  private static RobotBase m_robotCopy;
442  private static boolean m_suppressExitWarning;
443
444  /**
445   * Gets the Robot subclass name from a stack trace.
446   *
447   * @param elements The stack trace elements to walk.
448   * @return The Robot subclass name.
449   */
450  protected static String getRobotName(StackTraceElement[] elements) {
451    // Walk bottom to top to account for multiple layers of subclassing
452    for (int i = elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
453      StackTraceElement element = elements[i];
454      try {
455        // Skip our own class when walking
456        if (RobotBase.class.equals(Class.forName(element.getClassName()))) {
457          continue;
458        }
459        if (RobotBase.class.isAssignableFrom(Class.forName(element.getClassName()))) {
460          return element.getClassName();
461        }
462      } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
463        // Unreachable
464      }
465    }
466    return "Unknown";
467  }
468
469  /** Run the robot main loop. */
470  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
471  private static <T extends RobotBase> void runRobot(Supplier<T> robotConstructor) {
472    System.out.println("********** Robot program starting **********");
473
474    T robot;
475    try {
476      robot = robotConstructor.get();
477    } catch (Throwable throwable) {
478      Throwable cause = throwable.getCause();
479      if (cause != null) {
480        throwable = cause;
481      }
482      StackTraceElement[] elements = throwable.getStackTrace();
483      String robotName = getRobotName(elements);
484      DriverStationErrors.reportError(
485          "Unhandled exception instantiating robot " + robotName + " " + throwable, elements);
486      DriverStationErrors.reportError(
487          "The robot program quit unexpectedly."
488              + " This is usually due to a code error.\n"
489              + "  The above stacktrace can help determine where the error occurred.\n"
490              + "  See https://wpilib.org/stacktrace for more information.\n",
491          false);
492      DriverStationErrors.reportError("Could not instantiate robot " + robotName + "!", false);
493      DriverStationErrors.reportCrash("Could not instantiate robot " + robotName + "!", elements);
494      return;
495    }
496
497    m_runMutex.lock();
498    m_robotCopy = robot;
499    m_runMutex.unlock();
500
501    boolean errorOnExit = false;
502    try {
503      robot.startCompetition();
504    } catch (Throwable throwable) {
505      Throwable cause = throwable.getCause();
506      if (cause != null) {
507        throwable = cause;
508      }
509      DriverStationErrors.reportError(
510          "Unhandled exception: " + throwable, throwable.getStackTrace());
511      DriverStationErrors.reportCrash(
512          "Unhandled exception: " + throwable, throwable.getStackTrace());
513      errorOnExit = true;
514    } finally {
515      m_runMutex.lock();
516      boolean suppressExitWarning = m_suppressExitWarning;
517      m_runMutex.unlock();
518      if (!suppressExitWarning) {
519        // startCompetition never returns unless exception occurs....
520        DriverStationErrors.reportWarning(
521            "The robot program quit unexpectedly."
522                + " This is usually due to a code error.\n"
523                + "  The above stacktrace can help determine where the error occurred.\n"
524                + "  See https://wpilib.org/stacktrace for more information.",
525            false);
526        if (errorOnExit) {
527          DriverStationErrors.reportError(
528              "The startCompetition() method (or methods called by it) should have "
529                  + "handled the exception above.",
530              false);
531        } else {
532          DriverStationErrors.reportError(
533              "Unexpected return from startCompetition() method.", false);
534        }
535      }
536    }
537  }
538
539  /**
540   * Suppress the "The robot program quit unexpectedly." message.
541   *
542   * @param value True if exit warning should be suppressed.
543   */
544  public static void suppressExitWarning(boolean value) {
545    m_runMutex.lock();
546    m_suppressExitWarning = value;
547    m_runMutex.unlock();
548  }
549
550  /**
551   * Starting point for the applications.
552   *
553   * @param <T> Robot subclass.
554   * @param robotConstructor Robot constructor.
555   */
556  public static <T extends RobotBase> void startRobot(Supplier<T> robotConstructor) {
557    // Check that the MSVC runtime is valid.
558    WPIUtilJNI.checkMsvcRuntime();
559
560    if (!HAL.initialize()) {
561      throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to initialize. Terminating");
562    }
563    UsageReporting.setReportUsageImpl(HAL::reportUsage);
564
565    // Force refresh DS data
566    DriverStationBackend.refreshData();
567
568    UsageReporting.reportUsage("Language", "Java");
569    UsageReporting.reportUsage("WPILibVersion", WPILibVersion.Version);
570    HAL.publishWpilibVersion(WPILibVersion.Version + " (Java)");
571
572    if (HAL.hasMain()) {
573      Thread thread =
574          new Thread(
575              () -> {
576                runRobot(robotConstructor);
577                HAL.exitMain();
578              },
579              "robot main");
580      thread.setDaemon(true);
581      thread.start();
582      HAL.runMain();
583      suppressExitWarning(true);
584      m_runMutex.lock();
585      RobotBase robot = m_robotCopy;
586      m_runMutex.unlock();
587      if (robot != null) {
588        robot.endCompetition();
589      }
590      try {
591        thread.join(1000);
592      } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
593        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
594      }
595    } else {
596      runRobot(robotConstructor);
597    }
598
599    // On RIO, this will just terminate rather than shutting down cleanly (it's a no-op in sim).
600    // It's not worth the risk of hanging on shutdown when we want the code to restart as quickly
601    // as possible.
602    HAL.terminate();
603
604    HAL.shutdown();
605
606    System.exit(0);
607  }
